title: MILLPOKE
description: Millpoke is a lightweight modpack that enhances the Cobblemon experience by adding a few carefully selected Cobblemon add-ons.
body: Millpoke is a lightweight modpack that enhances the Cobblemon experience by adding a few carefully selected Cobblemon add-ons. These mods introduce new Pokémon-inspired features, improved battle mechanics, and extra customization options while keeping the gameplay close to vanilla Cobblemon. Perfect for players looking to expand their adventure without straying too far from the core experience!
